periods.office: Minister of Plantation and Commodities (Dec 2023-Dec 2025; moved to Investment, Trade and Industry in the 16 Dec 2025 reshuffle)

metrics.justification: No personal corruption or criminal matter of record. He chairs the government's 1MDB asset-recovery task force (a prosecutorial role, not as a defendant), and on taking the plantation portfolio he resigned as chairman of a palm-oil-linked company on 12 Dec 2023 to manage a disclosed conflict of interest; no regulatory or anti-corruption action arose.

citation.title: Johari Abdul Ghani resigns as CI Holdings chairman

BN (30 seats) holds the same index as PN (74 seats), 0.2214 — pivotal power is not seat count. Descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

metrics.justification: Handled the EU Deforestation Regulation pressure on palm oil: disputed Malaysia's "standard risk" classification as unfair (28 May 2025) while committing to keep working with the EU, and maintained Malaysia was "EUDR-ready" after the rule's delay. Active, measured pushback rather than evasion, outcome not yet a reclassification (anchor 2).

citation.title: Malaysia says its 'standard' risk classification under EUDR unfair

metrics.justification: Brought the mandatory MSPO 2.0 sustainable-palm-oil standard into operative effect (1 Jan 2025) with a smallholder-certification drive, and reported a National Traceability System integrating the sector's platforms; a rubber-smallholder consolidation programme stayed in-progress. Operative standard delivered alongside in-progress reforms (anchor 3).

citation.title: MPOB: More than 90% of independent smallholders to be MSPO-certified end-2025

metrics.justification: Secured an EU-Malaysia joint statement recognising MSPO as a credible sustainability scheme for deforestation-rule compliance (Sep 2025) and chaired a special inter-ministerial committee coordinating the response across agencies (26 Jun 2025). Documented international and whole-of-government instruments (anchor 3).

citation.title: EU acknowledges Malaysia's MSPO certification as credible standard for EUDR compliance
